description:
A team workspace for running AI coding agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees, live diff review, GitHub integration, and mobile access.

Lody is a team agent workspace: share coding agents with your team on phone and desktop. Shared sessions, live diffs, and one control plane keep your team and agents in sync.
Run agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees and live diff review, use subscriptions you already have with Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Kimi, and any agent that speaks ACP, manage the same control plane in the terminal with CLI commands, and ship together in one workspace with shared sessions, usage by member, and PR, CI, and merge status in-session.
Version 0.99.0
✨ New Features
- On iOS, choose the Aqua app icon in Appearance settings or switch back to the default icon.
🐛 Fixes & Improvements
- Fix startup failures after upgrades caused by outdated runtime caches. The affected runtime is downloaded and verified again when needed.
- Keep the app starting when runtime cache cleanup or update checks fail, without interrupting other runtimes.
